products.name: HeatReel
products.tagline: Skip to the parts everyone rewatches.
products.consumerDescription: HeatReel turns YouTube's "most replayed" heatmap into an instant highlight reel. One click jumps you between the peaks, auto-plays the best moments back-to-back, and adds playback controls YouTube forgot to ship.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: A MutationObserver watches YouTube's SPA navigation and lazily-rendered player chrome, then reads the crowd-replay heatmap's SVG <path> 'd' attribute. The Bézier commands are sampled into a normalized intensity curve, smoothed, and peak-detected with a prominence threshold to produce timestamped segments — no API keys, no network calls, everything runs client-side in a content script.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Zero backend · <5 ms segment extraction per video · survives YouTube DOM rewrites via resilient selectors

products.name: PsychoScanner
products.tagline: Grade a psychometric answer sheet in 3 seconds.
products.consumerDescription: Practicing for the Israeli Psychometric Entrance Exam? Snap a photo of your bubble sheet and PsychoScanner grades it instantly, shows your section scores, and tracks your progress across every practice test.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: The Expo client uploads a compressed capture to a FastAPI service. OpenCV finds the sheet's four fiducial corners via contour approximation, applies a perspective warp to a canonical template, then thresholds and samples each bubble ROI to compute fill ratios. Ambiguous marks are flagged rather than guessed, and results persist to SQLite for per-user progress analytics.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: ~3 s phone-to-score · robust to skew, shadows and partial lighting · deterministic template-based grading

products.name: Multiplayer Paraglider & Game Jams
products.tagline: Ride thermals with your friends. Plus a pile of 48-hour experiments.
products.consumerDescription: A real-time multiplayer 3D paragliding game — catch thermals, race ridgelines and soar together. Alongside it: a collection of rapid-prototype Game Jam titles you can play right in your browser.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Server-authoritative flight model built on Netcode for GameObjects: clients send input, the host simulates lift, drag and thermal fields, and state is replicated with client-side interpolation to keep gliders smooth over real-world latency.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Real-time multiplayer · jam prototypes shipped in 48–72 h

products.name: Stop For Me · עצור לי
products.tagline: Never watch your bus drive past again.
products.consumerDescription: A digital "stop button" for the bus stop. Tap to signal the driver that someone is waiting, so buses stop skipping riders — especially at night, in the rain, or for passengers who can't easily flag a bus down.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Riders emit a geo-verified stop request that is matched to the next approaching vehicle on the route; the SDK pushes a real-time alert to the driver-facing display and de-duplicates requests per stop to avoid alert fatigue. Designed as an embeddable SDK so existing transit apps can integrate the button.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Concept / R&D stage · co-founded transit venture
